Against the pass, IND allows 41.3% success [dc11], but a 10.5% explosive pass rate [dc13] is its leak, ranking 31st [dc14] over 585 plays [dc15]. HOU's average depth of target is the deepest in the league [dc16] on 319 targets [dc17], so vertical shots are the path. Third down is a strength: IND allows 32.2% conversions [dc19] on 118 attempts [dc20], ranked 5th [dc21]. Against the run, IND allows 42.6% success [dc25] on 251 carries [dc26], and HOU's run success is 33.3% [dc28] over 201 carries [dc29], with its run direction leaning right, ranked 3rd [dc27].

sections.heading: Special teams
sections.body: IND uses a single kicker, S.Shrader, who has made 23 [kc1] of 25 [kc2] field goals (92.0% [kc3]) and is 90.0% [kc4] from 50-plus on 10 [kc5] tries. HOU should treat long attempts as makeable but not automatic, so push for touchdowns once in range. Punting is IND's weaker unit: a net average of 42.3 yards [kc6] over 37 [kc7] punts ranks 17th [kc8], with 37.8% [kc9] landing inside the 20. Kickoffs are touchbacks 15.4% [kc10] of the time on 52 [kc11] kicks, so expect HOU to start most returns, averaging 25.2 yards [kc12] on 45 [kc13]. IND allows 6.5 yards [kc17] per punt return on 31 [kc18] returns, so HOU can attack punt coverage. IND's special-teams EPA of 0.06 [kc14] ranks 5th [kc15], while HOU sits at -0.02 [kc16].

sections.heading: Injuries and availability
sections.body: IND lists 7 players [ic2], led by T Jalen Travis, who is Out and whose snap share covers 9 games [ic5], so expect a backup tackle to take those reps. TE Mo Alie-Cox is also Out, though he takes just 1.9% of targets [ic7] on 308 team targets [ic8]. LB Jaylon Carlies and DT Jerry Tillery are also Out, thinning interior and linebacker depth against HOU's run game. HOU lists 11 players [ic11]. DE Danielle Hunter is Out, and his snap share covers 8 games [ic14], so IND's tackles should see less edge pressure. DE Will Anderson Jr. is Questionable. RB David Montgomery is Questionable and carries 25.9% of HOU's rushes [ic17] on 201 rushes [ic18]. WR Marvin Harrison Jr. is Out with a 3.6% target share [ic20].

sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: Several matchups will decide this game. IND sends 40.9% of designed runs right [mc1], but HOU allows -0.05 EPA per carry [mc2] over 218 plays [mc3], so keep the edge sound and let the front win first. Allen (18.8% [mc4]) and Downs (18.5% [mc5]) in the short game, with IND using play action on 28.7% [mc6] of dropbacks, require disciplined safeties and tackling after the catch, since HOU allows explosives on 10.1% [mc7] of pass plays. HOU has the deepest average target in the league [mc8] on 319 targets [mc9], and IND ranks 31st [mc10] in explosive plays allowed over 585 plays [mc11], so fake more to create vertical shots; HOU's play action share ranks 24th [mc12]. Finally, IND blitzes on 21.0% [mc13] of dropbacks against HOU's 12.3% pressure proxy [mc14] over 350 dropbacks [mc15]. IND tackle Jalen Travis is Out [mc16] after averaging 92.8% [mc17] of snaps this season, so expect backups inside and quick throws. HOU's Danielle Hunter is Out [mc18] and Will Anderson Jr. is Questionable [mc19], so the edge plan depends on Anderson's status.
